description:
Some of our members requested that I react to a video by Matt Whitman (@MattWhitmanTMBH) of the 10 Minute Bible Hour where he sat down with three Adventists to learn what the SDA Church formally teaches on a number of subjects and if it is within Christian orthodoxy.

CHAPTERS:
00:00 - Introduction
00:56 - Adventist Eschatology
05:41 - Adventism vs. Apostles Creed
11:07 - Great Controversy Theme and Doctrine
16:48 - Difference Between A Creed and 28 Fundamental Beliefs
20:10 - Updating the Fundamental Beliefs
21:20 - Rejecting the Creeds
25:00 - The Nature of Hell
31:55 - The SDA Forgotten Years
41:36 - Closing Remarks
